status: analytic candidate for independent role2 audit; no engineering prediction produced

domain.model: fixed real modal linear reference, classical diagonal modal damping
domain.output: fixed elastic shear c_r=B_sr*omega_r^2/1000, kN/m; damping-dependent output operators require extra product derivatives
domain.input: same ag and frozen interpolation/window; no candidate truth used

baseline_derivatives.compute: Save z/zdot and w/wdot from consistent baseline sensitivity states, not unqualified finite differences.
baseline_derivatives.negative_delta: Keep delta^3 sign in R2; absolute values enter only the norm bound.

residual_bound.Hstar_basis: L1 norm of candidate impulse kernel; only known candidate parameter used, not target forced response

optional_baseline_operator_bound.if_q_ge1: this bound unavailable, not infinite error; use predeclared known-operator bound or mark needs recomputation.

residual_bound.numerics: True continuous residual supremum or a certified enclosure is required for a continuous analytic bound; sampled maxima alone are empirical numerical bounds unless interpolation/integration/initial defects are bounded and added.
residual_bound.refinement: If pointwise convolution is used to reduce width, predeclare it and count its work; never calibrate the bound on candidate errors.

peak_and_decision.prediction: yhat=sum(c*p); Phat=max(abs(yhat)) over the entire frozen time window
peak_and_decision.Wmax: input, suggested first-demo0.05 of P0; root must freeze before target validation
peak_and_decision.uncertain: interval intersects decision boundary; full recomputation needed
peak_and_decision.wide_failure: width>Wmax is decision failure even if future truth is covered
peak_and_decision.zero_baseline: undefined improvement ratio, report force units only

peak_switch.full_window: Always maximize reconstructed predicted trace, not only old peak derivative
peak_switch.baseline_guard: K=norminf(yhat-y0)+E; if old-peak-region exterior margin>2*K, target peak remains in that region.
peak_switch.guard_failure: margin<=2*K means possible/unresolved switching, not proof of a switch
peak_switch.regions: baseline-defined peak neighborhoods plus remaining time, covering entire window
peak_switch.overlap: report control-peak uncertainty; do not discard new peaks outside old neighborhoods

validation_protocol.targets: session-plan batches .06/.07/.10/.12; historical8% is known-case validation, not blind
metrics: baseline derivative and bound computation work
validation_protocol.cost: Count sensitivity solves, interval propagation and peak search; do not assert speedup without measured comparison.
